subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context of the passage indicates that Gladolia responded quietly and indistinctly.
 
• **"Muttered" **means to speak in a low, indistinct voice, which fits the description of Gladolia’s response.
 
• The correct word for fill in the blanks no. 4 is '**muttered**'.

Complete Passage: *At the breakfast table the next morning, there was no sign of my wife. I concluded she was sleeping late, but Gladolia, upon being questioned, only shook her head, **muttered**__ something, and turned the whites of her eyes up to the ceiling. I was glad when the meal was finished and hurried to the library for another try at that story.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

"Mugged," "muffed," and "mutilated" have meanings unrelated to the action of speaking softly or indistinctly.

 
• **Mugged** (लूटा हुआ): "Mugged" means to be attacked and robbed in a public place, which does not relate to speaking softly.
 
• **Muffed** (गड़बड़ाया): "Muffed" means to handle a situation clumsily, which is not suitable in this context.
 
• **Mutilated** (विक्षत कर दिया): "Mutilated" means to severely damage or disfigure, which is unrelated to speaking.
